  [inst_4 : Algebra F L],
  (∀ (u : NumberField.FinitePlace F),
      Real.log ↑(AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.placeNorm u) / ↑(Module.finrank ℚ F) ≤
        ∑ w ∈ AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.placesOver L u,
            Real.log ↑(AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.placeNorm w) /
              ↑(Module.finrank ℚ L) +
          AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib L u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) →
    (Function.support fun (𝔭 : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers F)) =>
          AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib L 𝔭.asIdeal).Finite →
      Real.log ↑(Ideal.absNorm (differentIdeal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers F) (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L))) /
            ↑(Module.finrank ℚ L) =
          ∑ᶠ (𝔭 : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers F)),
            AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib L 𝔭.asIdeal →
        ∀ (S : Finset F) (T : Finset L),
          Finset.image (⇑(Algebra.algebraMap F L)) S ⊆ T →
            AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.finiteSetLogCond S ≤
              AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.finiteSetLogCond T +
                Real.log
                    ↑(Ideal.absNorm (differentIdeal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers F) (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L))) /
                  ↑(Module.finrank ℚ L)
